title: The fitted films on one street
body: The four fitted films, plus Olive Neg, on one frame at full strength, with every other control neutral. Olive Neg isn't fitted: it's a green-night film authored for the Underpass 400 recipe.

images.alt: A tree-lined Hanoi pavement with parked scooters, in six versions: no film, Memoir Chrome, Lost Summer Neg, Diary Neg, Afterglow Neg and Olive Neg.
images.caption: DSCF6296. Memoir Chrome quietens the greens, Lost Summer Neg and Afterglow Neg deepen the shade, Diary Neg stays close to the scene, and Olive Neg pushes everything toward green.
